name: Subaru Global platform transmission controller (CAN broadcast)
notes: The transmission frames of opendbc's subaru_global_2017.dbc (the DBC of every non-hybrid Subaru Global platform in car/subaru/values.py; hybrids use another DBC and are not covered) plus the wheel-speed frame. Only Transmission.Gear has a value table upstream; the CVT frame and the RPM field are layout-only. Checksums are not verified. No gearbox codes, part numbers or flash layout are claimed, so identify is empty. The UDS channel is untested (validation: implemented); some fingerprints answer at 0x7A3 instead of 0x7E1.

diagnostics.name: uds
diagnostics.notes: Request id from opendbc car/subaru/fingerprints.py (Ecu.transmission 0x7E1; two platforms use 0x7A3), response = request + 8 (ISO 15765-4, opendbc's default rx_offset). 22 F182 is the application-data identification opendbc's firmware query sends (SUBARU_VERSION_REQUEST). Not tried on a car.

buses.name: global
buses.description: Subaru Global platform CAN as opendbc's subaru_global_2017.dbc describes it
buses.notes: 500 kbit/s is assumed (the OBD-II CAN rate of ISO 15765-4); opendbc does not state bus rates.

frames.name: Transmission
frames.notes: Transmission status (subaru_global_2017.dbc). opendbc reads the shifter position from Gear.

signals.name: CHECKSUM
signals.notes: Checksum byte (algorithm in opendbc's Subaru CAN code; not verified here).

signals.name: Gear
signals.notes: Selector / gear: opendbc's value table (1-6 are the manual-mode steps).

signals.name: RPM
signals.notes: 15-bit speed value; the DBC gives no unit or scale and opendbc does not read it.

signals.name: CVT_Gear
signals.notes: CVT gear byte; no value table in the source (opendbc does not read it).

frames.name: Wheel_Speeds
frames.notes: Wheel speeds (_subaru_global.dbc). On Global Gen2 platforms opendbc reads this frame from its second bus.

signals.name: FR
signals.notes: Wheel speed front right (raw x 0.057 km/h).

signals.name: RR
signals.notes: Wheel speed rear right (raw x 0.057 km/h).

signals.name: FL
signals.notes: Wheel speed front left (raw x 0.057 km/h).

signals.name: RL
signals.notes: Wheel speed rear left (raw x 0.057 km/h).

safety: OpenTune only listens to these broadcast frames (and, where a diagnostic channel is listed, reads identification); it never writes to this controller.
Do not transmit on a drivetrain CAN bus of a moving car: these frames feed the engine, brakes and instrument cluster. Log with a listen-only adapter.
